name: Fading Warmth
description: Warm the cooling hands and feet of a dying ally to hold the last of the life in the body.

name: Waning Draw
description: Draw the sharp pain from a failing ally so the ally may rest without losing the little life left.

name: Ebb Sounding
description: Sound the ebb of an ally's life to learn how near the end is and how much can be held back.

name: Rot Release
description: Release the creeping rot of death from an ally's limb while the living flesh around it is kept.

name: Vital Anchor
description: Anchor the wavering life of an ally with a steady thread of vitality so it cannot slip loose.

name: Deathward Jolt
description: Jolt the flow of ruin in a death-touched target with a pulse of life that breaks its working.

name: Undoing Pulse
description: Undo a fresh death by sending a long pulse of life across the moment of the stopping.

name: Quiet Barrier
description: Raise a barrier that lets vitality in and keeps the cold touch of death out.

name: Twilight Mercy
description: Spread a balanced mercy over the wounded so none suffers longer than needed and all who can be saved are.

name: Reborn Blossom
description: streams: Life + Death; Bloom a flower of ended and renewed life over the fallen that brings them back and shuts out further dying.

name: Lit Warmth
description: Kindle a gentle living flame in the palm and lay it on an ally's chill to drive the cold out.

name: Cinder Balm
description: Rub a warm cinder balm of qi into an ally's burn to cool the pain and begin the new skin.

name: Hot Vigor
description: Stoke a hot vigor in an ally's limbs so strength and speed flare for several exchanges.

name: Flare Fist
description: Flare vitality into flame at the knuckles and punch a burning blow into the target's guard.

name: Fever Scorching
description: Burn a sickness out of an ally's blood with a controlled warm flame that leaves the flesh whole.

name: Cauterizing Touch
description: Cauterize a spurting wound with a flash of life-fed flame that seals it without a scar.

name: Whitehot Needle
description: Heat a needle of vitality white and drive it through the target's guard into the muscle.

name: Flameskin
description: Wear a skin of living flame that burns away thrown things and scorches those who strike it.

name: Warmflame Recall
description: Call a fallen ally back with a warm clean flame set to the chest that starts the heart.

name: Flare Burst
description: Burst the stored flame of vitality outward in a roaring ring that scorches all who stand near.

name: Scorching Bloom
description: Cast a blooming sheet of living flame across the ground that burns the enemy and spares the allied.

name: Lifeflame Mantle
description: streams: Life + Fire; Wrap an ally in a living flame that burns off taint and rebuilds torn flesh in a heartbeat.

name: Stretched Salve
description: Stretch a salve of qi across a short fold of space to reach a wound the hand cannot touch.

name: Folded Balm
description: Fold the space beside a wounded ally onto the user's palm and ease the hurt through it.

name: Far Sensing
description: Fold a thread of awareness out across a distance and feel the living pulses at the far end.

name: Folded Step
description: Fold a short gap shut with vitality and step across it to stand beside a wounded ally.

name: Distant Rinse
description: Rinse a poison from an ally across a fold of space without ever touching the body.

name: Seam Closing
description: Close a gaping seam in an ally's flank by folding the torn edges together through space.

name: Folded Guard
description: Fold the path of a blow around the body so it passes through the space beside it.

name: Gapped Palm
description: Fold the gap away at the instant of a strike so a vitality palm lands from beyond reach.

name: Far Recall
description: Recall a fallen ally lying far away by folding the space between and pouring vitality through.

name: Fold Lance
description: Fold a lance of vitality across the gap so it enters the target before the lance is seen.

name: Seedfold Wave
description: Fold a wave of renewal across the whole field so wounds close even beyond the user's sight.

name: Seedfold Reach
description: streams: Life + Space; Fold the distance away so renewal reaches a wounded ally across a gulf as if beside the user.

name: Spirit Warmth
description: Warm the shivering spirit of an ally who has taken a bad fright and settle the breath.

name: Anima Balm
description: Spread a balm of life over an ally's tired spirit so the heart and mind steady together.

name: Bright Spirit
description: Lift an ally's flagging spirit with a bright flow of vitality so courage returns with strength.

name: Soulwarm Sensing
description: Feel the warmth of an ally's spirit and learn whether it burns bright or gutters.

name: Dread Lifting
description: Lift the clinging dread of a shaken mind out of an ally with a clear cool pulse.

name: Erosion Rinse
description: Rinse the creeping erosion of a damaged soul from an ally with a warm tide of life.

name: Anima Weave
description: Weave the frayed edges of an ally's spirit together with the same threads that mend flesh.

name: Spirit Shell
description: Wrap an ally's spirit in a shell of life that turns aside a soul-touching blow.

name: Spirit Recall
description: Recall a spirit that has just left its body and settle it back into the stilled heart.

name: Wakened Anima
description: Wake the stunned spirit of a collapsed ally with a long call of life through the chest.

name: Spirit Aegis
description: Raise an aegis of life about an ally's spirit that nullifies a draining or binding soul attack.

name: Anima Return
description: Cast a great call of life and spirit over a lifeless ally to bring body and spirit back together.

name: Soulbloom Weave
description: streams: Life + Soul; Weave a blooming thread of life through an ally's torn spirit until it is whole again.

name: Livingsoul Return
description: streams: Life + Soul; Call a lifeless ally's living soul home and bind it fast to the waking body.
